title: Govinda's Son Yashvardhan Ahuja Locks Bollywood Debut With Entire Family On Board
excerpt: The Ahuja family turns Yashvardhan's first film into a three-generation affair, with mother Sunita acting alongside him and Govinda returning for a special dance number.
body:
• Yashvardhan Ahuja will make his Bollywood debut in Hero Ki Horrorine, a horror film directed by Sajid Khan and produced by Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms.
  • His mother Sunita Ahuja plays his on-screen mother — reportedly the first time a real mother-son duo are being launched together in Hindi cinema.
  • Govinda will shoot a special dance number with his son, marking their first on-screen collaboration and Govinda's Bollywood return since Rangeela Raja in 2019.
  • The film, which began shooting in January 2026 at Mumbai's Film City, co-stars Nitanshi Goel and is expected to release in September.

Yashvardhan Ahuja's Bollywood debut is shaping up to be the most thorough family launch the Hindi film industry has seen in years. The son of veteran actor Govinda will star in Hero Ki Horrorine, a horror film directed by Sajid Khan, with his mother Sunita Ahuja playing his on-screen mother and his father set to return to the big screen for a special dance number.

The film, produced by Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms alongside Amar Butala's Guilty By Association Media, began shooting on January 23 at Mumbai's Film City. It was previously titled Hundred before the name change.

A Family Affair

Sunita Ahuja confirmed her involvement in a recent interview, saying the film marks the first time in Hindi cinema that a real mother and son are being launched together. "I'm working on a film with Yash, which is slated to release in September. I have immense love and respect for Ekta Kapoor," she told ANI. "In Yash's film, I'm playing his mother. Perhaps it's the first time in the industry that a mother and son are being launched together."

Govinda's participation adds another layer to the project. According to the Times of India, he will shoot a special song with Yashvardhan over a two-day schedule, marking their first on-screen collaboration. The appearance will also mark Govinda's return to Bollywood after Rangeela Raja in 2019 — a seven-year absence from the big screen.

"I just want to say that I hope you all shower my son Yash with the same love and blessings that you have always given me."

— Sunita Ahuja

The Cast and Crew

Joining Yashvardhan is Nitanshi Goel, who gained widespread recognition for her performance in Laapataa Ladies (2024). For director Sajid Khan, the project marks a return to filmmaking after a lengthy hiatus — his last directorial was Humshakals in 2014. He stepped away from Housefull 4 following serious allegations. Khan had suffered a foot fracture during a December 2025 shoot in Mumbai but recovered after surgery.

The film also represents a genre shift for Khan, who built his career on broad comedies. His directorial journey actually began with a horror short in Darna Zaroori Hai (2006), making this project a return to his earliest instincts.

Carrying Forward a Legacy

Yashvardhan, 29, trained at the Met Film School in London and worked as an assistant director on films including Tadap and Dishoom before stepping in front of the camera. His elder sister Tina Ahuja had her Bollywood debut with Second Hand Husband in 2015.

The debut comes during a turbulent period for the Ahuja family. Sunita had filed for divorce from Govinda amid a public spat that played out across media and social platforms through much of August, including accusations and counter-accusations. She withdrew the divorce petition on August 19, just days before Hero Ki Horrorine is expected to ramp up its promotional campaign ahead of the September release.

What to Watch For

Producer Amar Butala brings a track record that includes Mission Majnu, Kesari, Total Dhamaal, and Bajrangi Bhaijaan. Whether Yashvardhan can translate the Govinda name into a fresh career of his own — in a genre his father never explored — will be one of the more watched Bollywood debuts of the year.
